payload.title: Measure before and after on a fixed held-out set and show it in the shared UI
payload.description:
## Why
Cyclotron is the evidence product. The headline is a visible before-and-after number from human labels in a hosted Papyrus newsroom (Ryan, portfolio review 2026-10-16). Papyrus owns the UI path; Cyclotron owns the metric, the held-out set and the report format, exposed through the shared remote and embedded UI.

## What
- Metric: balanced accuracy (mean per-label agreement), with accuracy, positive-label precision and recall, and per-label agreement. Items weighted by inverse selection propensity so tapered review rates do not bias it.
- Held-out set: frozen from program- or audit-selected reviews of audit-share items, which never train, tune or prime. Frozen sets copy values and labels and never change.
- Endpoints: version 1 as created (seed rubric and priming) versus the active classifier, same items and request clock. Paired exact sign test; verdict improved, worse, no-clear-change, too-few-labels (default 10 per label) or nothing-learned-yet.
- Report: cyclotron-held-out-report/v1 JSON Schema, example and TypeScript types.
- Engine: freeze_held_out_set, held_out_request_bound, evaluate_held_out, held_out_reports on both the SQLite and S3 stores.
- Shared UI: HeldOutReportView and HeldOutPanel, createHeldOutClient, and GraphQL heldOutOverview / heldOutCommand served by HeldOutService in either mode. Evaluation needs live authority and a confirmed request bound.
- Docs: docs/held-out-measurement.md.

```gherkin
Feature: Before and after on a fixed held-out set
  Scenario: A learned rubric shows as a clear improvement
    Given a cyclotron that promoted a new version from reviews
    And a held-out set frozen from its audit reviews
    When the held-out set is evaluated
    Then the report shows version 1 and the active version on the same items
    And the verdict is improved only when the sign test clears and each label has enough items
  Scenario: Re-evaluating costs nothing when nothing changed
    When the same set is evaluated again
    Then no new decision-model request is made
```

Remaining for hosted acceptance: Papyrus mounts HeldOutService behind its account and publication grant and places HeldOutPanel; a live evaluation on a hosted newsroom needs its own approved budget.
